Remark
[Noncharacteristic condition for a general boundary] ↗ def:noncharacteristic-triple 1. ch3:3.2.3-rem-1\group Method of Characteristics

For a smooth boundary with unit normal $ u $, the invariant condition is \[ D_pF(p^0,z^0,x^0)\cdot u (x^0) e 0. \]
